claims.text: Royal Order A/224 dated 29/11/1432 AH (dateline Riyadh 29 Dhu al-Qa'da 1432 / 27 October 2011): King Abdullah, having notified the chairman and members of the Allegiance Commission, chose Prince Nayef bin Abdulaziz as Crown Prince and ordered his appointment as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior.
claims.locator: Dateline; order number and date; operative paragraph
claims.uncertainty: The order says the Commission was notified; it reports no Commission vote. The release was filed at 00:51 Makkah time on 28 October 2011, and the portal's date_hijri field (1432-12-01) reflects that filing day, not the order date. The printed order date, 29/11/1432 AH, which the dateline equates with 27 October 2011, stands.

claims.text: The order's preamble cites the Basic Law of Governance (Royal Order A/90 of 27/8/1412 AH), the Council of Ministers Law (Royal Order A/13 of 3/3/1414 AH), the Allegiance Commission Law (Royal Order A/135 of 26/9/1427 AH) and item Third of A/135.
claims.uncertainty: Citations inside a later order, not the establishing instruments. Their Gregorian dates were not verified here.

scope_note: The release ends with 'to follow'; any continuation was not read. published_date is the printed dateline; the portal timestamp is 00:52 Makkah time on 28 October 2011. Used for SA-EXEC-03.
